writeup: Woot has a new Case-Mate Floral Gems MagSafe case for iPhone 17 Pro (MPN CM057300) at $14.99. This is the gold rhinestone floral shell with built-in MagSafe, and Case-Mate rates it for drops up to 12 feet. Cases currently lists the same CM057300 at $44.99 after its site code, while Abt, Verizon, and Target have it at $49.99 and Case-Mate's site is at $50. That is 66 percent and about $30 below the lowest of those store prices. Quantity is 3+ left, with a limit of 3 per customer.
